newsitem.title: USA: Piedmont Bancorp sets special $7.00/shr div.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont Bancorp sets special $7.00/shr div.

text.p: Piedmont Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it declared a one-time cash dividend of $7 per share to be paid on December 6 to shareholders of record on November 25.
Based on preliminary estimates, the company said about 95 percent of the distribution is expected to be considered a return of capital.

The portion of the distribution which is treated as a return of capital would be viewed as a reduction in the cost basis of each share and would not be subject to income tax as a dividend to shareholders, the company said.
A final determination of the amount to be treated as a return of capital will be made as soon as practicable after Dec. 31, 1996, the company said.

The company's earnings for the quarter ending Dec. 31, 1996 are expected to be reduced due to losses that will be recognized upon the liquidation of securities to fund the cash dividend, the company said.
